recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future digital-signature behavior changes should be handled through current Security/FHIR-I signature-page Jira items and work group review rather than reopening this DSTU1 audit item.
issue_request: FHIR-3746 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Security request for advice on creating and validating Provenance.signature, handling moved/imported resources, rewritten references, metadata, versioned references, server relocation, counter-signatures, and document signatures. The resolution recommended W3C/XML Digital Signatures, Provenance as a detached-signature carrier through Signature, document signing through enveloped/IHE DSG mechanisms, and preserving other signature approaches.
initial_application: No available HL7/fhir commit names FHIR-3746 directly. Pickaxe history shows the resolution-family text present in early source/security.html by commit 6bf66c1 and moved to the dedicated source/signatures.html page by commit 9071f6d0, which also linked the Security summary to signatures.html.
additional_context: The current signatures page has since been substantively rewritten and maintained by later signature work. It now includes cautions about URLs, identifiers, references, metadata, RESTful create/update behavior and server movement; canonicalization variants; JWS and XML signature methods; Provenance-carried signatures; document/Bundle signing; and counter-signing. Security and documentation navigation link to signatures.html, and later community evidence supports that this is the active guidance location.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/signatures.html already covers the semantic guidance requested by FHIR-3746. Adding a narrow historical paragraph would duplicate the current maintained page and risk drift.
